understanding.goal_understanding: The goal in each level was to place every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' at the same time; if there were multiple '+' tiles, all had to be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN, and completing all levels would win the full KA59 puzzle run within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempted to shift the currently selected piece by one cell (3 pixels) in that direction; moves could be blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects, and the 'movement.*_blocked' flags were only heuristic hints rather than guarantees. Some adjacent objects (blocks) could be pushed if immediately next to the selected piece in the move direction, causing both to shift if space allowed. Levels with multiple selectables required using CLICK on the exact pixel coordinates of another selectable to change which piece was controlled.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal in each level was to place every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' at the same time; if there were multiple '+' tiles, all had to be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN, and completing all levels would win the full KA59 puzzle run within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempted to shift the currently selected piece by one cell (3 pixels) in that direction; moves could be blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects, and the 'movement.*_blocked' flags were only heuristic hints rather than guarantees. Some adjacent objects (blocks) could be pushed if immediately next to the selected piece in the move direction, causing both to shift if space allowed. Levels with multiple selectables required using CLICK on the exact pixel coordinates of another selectable to change which piece was controlled.
